source.description: Follow-up from xtrm-h9hqg. Implementation added `xt update --all-repos` with dry-run inventory and --apply per-repo commits, but this session intentionally did not mutate the whole local fleet after smoke. Expected commit per changed repo: `chore: apply bd auto-stage patch (xtrm-tools auto-applied)`. Capture results in bead notes.
